ValidationRule.description: Spend (as truncated percent of budget) may not exceed the time-prorated share of the timeline plus a priority-based allowance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Budget__c)), Budget__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Spent__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), NOT(Is_Approved__c), TRUNC(Spent__c / MAX(1, Budget__c) * 100, 0) > FLOOR(100 * MIN(1, MAX(0, (TODAY() - Start_Date__c) / MAX(1, End_Date__c - Start_Date__c))) + CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 30, 'High', 20, 10)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Spent is burning faster than the timeline and priority allow.
